title: Voxon Shield application assertion
description: JWT Claims Set for a mock-only local Shield assertion. Applications receive derived booleans only. This is not a production identity credential.

iss.description: Shield issuer identifier. Verifiers must match this exactly and bind verification keys to it.

aud.description: Single application audience. An EverCommons assertion must not verify for another app.

sub.description: Pairwise pseudonymous subject for this audience. Must not be a name, email, or shared cross-app identifier.

iat.description: Issued-at time as seconds since Unix epoch (RFC 7519).

nbf.description: Optional not-before time as seconds since Unix epoch (RFC 7519).

exp.description: Expiration time as seconds since Unix epoch. Must be after iat and within the max TTL.

jti.description: Unique assertion id (RFC 7519). Local mock uses a UUID.
